page.overview:
Who is Loffrey Wodring?

Loffrey Wodring, also known as Rofel Wodring, is a secondary antagonist in Final Fantasy Tactics. He is one of two Knights Templar who accompany Folmarv Tengille, acting as one of his trusted men.

A devout follower of the Church of Glabados, in his youth Loffrey studied theology as a monk before joining the Knights Templar order. Although he did not serve directly in the Fifty Years' War, he was part of the armed escort of High Confessor Marcel Funebris, Cardinal Alphonse Delacroix, and other Church officials during their visits to soldiers on the front lines. It was there that Loffrey met Folmarv Tengille, Lord Commander of the Templars, whose ideals captivated him. The two then became friends and began working closely together, to the point where he swore loyalty and obedience to the man.

At some point, Loffrey came to believe that Folmarv was the reincarnation of Saint Ajora and began to help him in the search for the Zodiac Stones, believing that he would use the power of the auracites to save Ivalice from the misery and destruction, just as the Zodiac Braves had done. Unknown to Loffrey, however, was that Folmarv was actually possessed by the Lucavi Hashmal and wanted to use the power of the stones to incite mass chaos so that he could resurrect his leader, the Angel of Blood, Ultima. This resulted not only in Loffrey, but also many other Knights Templar, such as Cletienne Duroi, and Folmarv's sons, Meliadoul and Isilud, being used as pawns to achieve the Lucavi's objectives.

Loffrey was assigned to recruit the former leader of the Corpse Brigade, Wiegraf Folles, into the Knights Templar. Finding Wiegraf at his sister's grave, he initially refused the offer. Loffrey then convinced Wiegraf by telling him the Corpse Brigade and the Church of Glabados have the same goal: the removal of Ivalice's aristocracy.
